name: MCP vs CLI vs Skills: What Each Costs in Context
title: MCP vs CLI vs Skills: What Each Costs in Context
summary: Every tool you give an agent sends its definition to the model on every request, and you pay for it as input tokens. A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server can add tens of thousands of tokens to the context window. The usual alternatives are a command-line tool (CLI) or a skill.
